storyInfo: As Amiya searches for medicine, she is led to a patient suffering from an unknown illness by an unfamiliar creature. She brings the patient to the local clinic and encounters Hierda there.

attributes.content: How is the Generalik?
attributes.name: Composed Soldier

attributes.content: He's sleeping.
attributes.name: Hierda

attributes.content: Is he out of danger?
attributes.name: Composed Soldier

attributes.content: Yes.
attributes.name: Hierda

attributes.content: In that case, you should get some rest too. I will keep watch.
attributes.name: Composed Soldier

attributes.content: Thank you for all that you've done for the general.
attributes.name: Composed Soldier

attributes.content: No... I simply try to give comfort to everyone who needs it.
attributes.name: Hierda

attributes.content: I'm not tired. I think there might be other people here who need my help.
attributes.name: Hierda

attributes.content: I would like to go out and find them.
attributes.name: Hierda

attributes.content: We cannot deny your requests... but the Generalik's orders were for you to remain by his side.
attributes.name: Composed Soldier

attributes.content: He will not be happy if he wakes up and finds that you are missing.
attributes.name: Composed Soldier

attributes.content: I promise, I won't be away for long. Please, give me a chance... a chance to do more, in order to enrich my soul.
attributes.name: Hierda

attributes.content: Very well, but please be careful.
attributes.name: Composed Soldier

attributes.content: The city is currently taking in additional Infected. We cannot guarantee that these ruffians will not cause trouble.
attributes.name: Composed Soldier

attributes.content: I'll be careful.
attributes.name: Hierda

attributes.content: Please, my friend is in bad shape! I need to get medicine!
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: As I said, there is a strict curfew in place here.
attributes.name: Soldier

attributes.content: Either you submit a request and wait for a decision, or hand the patient to us, and we'll transport her to receive treatment.
attributes.name: Soldier

attributes.content: But you don't allow anyone to go with! There's no time, I have to—
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: Not before sunrise. It's the rules.
attributes.name: Soldier

attributes.content: Purr...
Huh?
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: Now go back.
attributes.name: Soldier

attributes.content: What that—in the bushes behind you?
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: That sort of trick won't work—
attributes.name: Soldier

attributes.content: *roar*—!
Target has been spotted in Naberezhnaya, near the Third District.
attributes.name: Voice from Communicator

attributes.content: Ponjal. Reinforcements are on their way.
attributes.name: Voice from Communicator

attributes.content: Wait, is that really—
attributes.name: Soldier

attributes.content: Backup! I need backup!
attributes.name: Soldier

attributes.content: The soldier quickly turns around and calls to his comrades near the building.
Amiya takes one last look at the shadow darting through the bushes, and takes off in the opposite direction.
<p=1>City of Zelgrad</><p=2> Jan 21, 1102, 01:25</>
attributes.name: group_location_stamp

attributes.content: (Phew...)
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: (This was the busy street we saw during the day.)
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: (Hm—)
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: —I'm sorry, I'm sorry!
attributes.name: Distant Voice

attributes.content: I got held up checking the boilers, I'll go home immediately—
attributes.name: Distant Voice

attributes.content: You will be detained and fined for violation of curfew.
attributes.name: Robotic Voice

attributes.content: Do not attempt to resist.
attributes.name: Robotic Voice

attributes.content: Please, I have to go to work tomorrow—
attributes.name: Distant Voice

attributes.content: (I have to avoid the searchlights. But why is there such a strict curfew here?)
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: (I hope I can find more medicine for Arts overload reactions...)
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: (Raidian...)
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: The city of Zelgrad feels dark, even with lamps on both sides of the streets, as though neither the twin moons nor the stars shine upon it.
Amiya dashes along the side of the street, dodging the ever-present searchlights, looking up at the signs on the buildings.
*Whimper*
It's you... Are the people looking for you nearby? Why are they chasing you?
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: (Rubs against Amiya)
(Tugs at Amiya's skirt)
Oh... where are you taking me?
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: I'm sorry, I don't have time—
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: Purr!
The 'cloudbeast' in the shadows keeps tugging at Amiya's skirt, trying to pull her towards a nearby alley.
Looking in that direction, Amiya sees that there is an area of shadow that the searchlights do not touch.
Hm—
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: I should check it out.
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: What is this...
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: A figure sits by the wall in the shadows beyond the searchlights' reach, hardly human anymore.
What little skin is visible through the bandages that almost completely cover his body shows a shade of eerie, translucent green.
Skin and muscle tissue on his arm are forming small clumps like moss and peeling off.
All he can do is wrap his arm in more bandages, as though hoping it will slow the departure of his skin and flesh.
(Hoarse wailing)
attributes.name: Strange Man

attributes.content: Wh-What happened to you?
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: Mur...
attributes.name: Strange Man

attributes.content: Mur... where are you?
attributes.name: Strange Man

attributes.content: Purr...
Mur? Is this its name?
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: The light from the searchlights finally allows Amiya to see the 'cloudbeast' clearly.
*sniffles*—
attributes.name: Strange Creature

attributes.content: The strange creature growls softly, as though confirming that Amiya has found the man, then disappears into the night.
I can't see... I can't see! Where are you, Mur?
attributes.name: Strange Man

attributes.content: The twisted figure stumbles towards her, his soggy flesh making a sickening sound underneath his bandages.
He does not realize that he would reveal himself to the searchlights if he took one step further. Amiya dashes forward and stops him.
Look out—!
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: Who?
attributes.name: Strange Man

attributes.content: Who's there...
attributes.name: Strange Man

attributes.content: What... what's this sickness?
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: I-Is there any way I can help?
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: My goodness, your arm...
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: Amiya catches the man as he collapses. He emanates the scent of a rotten bog as his limbs twitch.
It is the scent of death.
Mur... Mulka!
attributes.name: Strange Man

attributes.content: All of you...
attributes.name: Strange Man

attributes.content: ...left me...
attributes.name: Strange Man

attributes.content: Will never, see again.
attributes.name: Strange Man

attributes.content: Will never...
'Will never see again.'
In the man's confusion and pain, Amiya once again touches the emotion that causes her pain.
A black crown appears above her head.
As she touches his consciousness, she sees a small cabin, a woman and child who never returned after leaving home, a cloudbeast leaps from the window sill—
And a man who brought back a monster.
'The collapse in the new industrial district caused nineteen deaths and thirty-four injuries at a nearby school.'
attributes.name: Voice From Radio

attributes.content: '...We express our deepest regrets for the accident. Compensation has been issued to those affected...'
attributes.name: Voice From Radio

attributes.content: I won't open the window again, Mur. I won't give you another chance.
attributes.name: Familiar Man

attributes.content: Purr?
I won't open the door again...
attributes.name: Familiar Man

attributes.content: I won't open it for anyone.
attributes.name: Familiar Man

attributes.content: You and I will be the only ones here.
attributes.name: Familiar Man

attributes.content: Forever...
attributes.name: Familiar Man

attributes.content: '...An experimental animal escaped from the industrial district. Anyone with information should call the Department of Livestock at 10103. A reward is being offered...'
attributes.name: Voice From Radio

attributes.content: Purr...
We'll never leave each other. They won't take anything else from me.
attributes.name: Strange Man

attributes.content: Yes, that's it...
attributes.name: Strange Man

attributes.content: Kirill!
attributes.name: Voice Outside the Door

attributes.content: Kirill! Are you home?
attributes.name: Voice Outside the Door

attributes.content: I haven't seen you at the factory in a week. Are you alright?
attributes.name: Voice Outside the Door

attributes.content: If you are, go talk to the supervisor and get formal approval for leave, okay? They won't let me do it on your behalf—
attributes.name: Voice Outside the Door

attributes.content: Kirill...
attributes.name: Voice Outside the Door

attributes.content: If you can hear me, remember that you can rely on us.
attributes.name: Voice Outside the Door

attributes.content: We're a community, remember?
attributes.name: Voice Outside the Door

attributes.content: Your condition, 'Mur', and that voice outside the door—
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: What's all this about...?
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: Oh—
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: (Oh no, they found me!)
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: (I must buy time, try to get this patient out from here.)
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: (He's unconscious. I have to hurry—)
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: Target acquired.
attributes.name: Robotic Voice

attributes.content: Do not attempt to resist.
attributes.name: Robotic Voice

attributes.content: Third District patrols, in position.
attributes.name: Robotic Voice

attributes.content: (I can't get caught right now. I have to figure out what's going on with this man. This could be what Zelgrad is trying to hide—)
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: (I remember now. That woman at the transfer area was saying something about dust and infection. Now I see a patient with strange symptoms... yes...)
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: I'm sorry, I must—
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: Do not attempt to resist.
attributes.name: Robotic Voice

attributes.content: Do not—
attributes.name: Robotic Voice

attributes.content: You there! Follow me!
This way!
<p=1>City of Zelgrad, Underground Residential Layer</><p=2> Jan 21, 1102, 02:16</>
attributes.name: group_location_stamp

attributes.content: The streets are empty... but the underground is much busier.
attributes.name: Hierda

attributes.content: Is this where the Infected was pointing me to?
attributes.name: Hierda

attributes.content: Go get help, we need extra hands—
attributes.name: Busy Worker

attributes.content: Oh. What are you doing here, kid?
attributes.name: Busy Worker

attributes.content: Is something wrong?
attributes.name: Hierda

attributes.content: The pub owner Prokhor is dead! Looks like a robbery-murder. His body was found in the sewers. Who would have thought something like this could happen in Zelgrad?
attributes.name: Busy Worker

attributes.content: The sewer cleaners found him. We need more people to haul the body up, and then we'll report it in the morning...
attributes.name: Busy Worker

attributes.content: Oh, why am I even telling you this, just make way, I need to get help.
attributes.name: Busy Worker

attributes.content: I'm no help when it comes to something like this... sorry.
attributes.name: Hierda

attributes.content: It's alright.
attributes.name: Busy Worker

attributes.content: (Is this where they found the body?)
attributes.name: Hierda

attributes.content: (There's someone here...)
attributes.name: Hierda

attributes.content: Excuse me—
attributes.name: Hierda

attributes.content: You found someone?
attributes.name: Surprised Worker

attributes.content: A kid? What are you doing here? Where are your parents? This is no place for you.
attributes.name: Surprised Worker

attributes.content: I would like to ask for directions. Can you point me to people who need help?
attributes.name: Hierda

attributes.content: People suffering from Oripathy, or other kinds of illness and pain...
attributes.name: Hierda

attributes.content: Weird kid... I guess you're looking for a hospital? Someone in your family got sick or hurt?
attributes.name: Surprised Worker
Hierda
attributes.content: Hospital...

attributes.name: Hierda
attributes.content: That works too.
Well, you'll only get arrested if you go outside now. But there's a place I can point you to if you need a doctor urgently...
attributes.name: Surprised Worker

attributes.content: She'll treat anyone, as long as you have money.
attributes.name: Surprised Worker

attributes.content: 'Go out the steel door with a red circle on it, and take the path without street lamps or searchlights.'
'Keep going until you reach a wall. Crouch down and shove at the wall until you find a spot that's loose.'
'That's the door that leads to an abandoned factory, where you'll find the clinic and doctor you're looking for.'
Doctor... doctor...
attributes.name: Suffering Infected

attributes.content: Painkillers, please, give me painkillers! I'll give you all the factory scrips I have! I can't take it anymore, I can hear the rocks grow beneath my skin—
attributes.name: Suffering Infected

attributes.content: The doctor said not to rely on medicine until the pain reaches a certain threshold. It'll keep you from developing resistance too quickly, and make the meds last longer.
attributes.name: Optimistic Infected

attributes.content: Just hang in there... we've got to get back to the factories after we get our meds for the day. You need to rest while you can.
attributes.name: Optimistic Infected

attributes.content: I can't stand...
attributes.name: Suffering Infected

attributes.content: You're just imagining it! You're hurting so much that you can't feel anything. Let's see what degree of pain it corresponds to—
attributes.name: Optimistic Infected

attributes.content: Hey, I think you're allowed meds now.
attributes.name: Optimistic Infected

attributes.content: Quick, ask—ask for me!
attributes.name: Suffering Infected

attributes.content: Please, allow me to help.
attributes.name: Hierda

attributes.content: Who are you?
attributes.name: Optimistic Infected

attributes.content: I don't care who you are, just help me—please!
attributes.name: Suffering Infected

attributes.content: What are you talking about? We don't even know who she is—
attributes.name: Optimistic Infected

attributes.content: Hierda walks forward and takes the hands of the Infected on the stretcher in her own.
Tiny Originium grow from his ice-cold hands and legs. They can cause such lingering pain that death easily becomes preferable.
What are you doing? I'm calling for the doctor. Doctor! Doctor Nadezhda Pavlovna!
attributes.name: Optimistic Infected

attributes.content: *pant*... *pant*...
attributes.name: Suffering Infected

attributes.content: Wait... your Originium is changing color?
attributes.name: Optimistic Infected

attributes.content: I can't do much, but I can at least stop the pain.
attributes.name: Hierda

attributes.content: ...Is he dead?
attributes.name: Optimistic Infected

attributes.content: No, I think—
attributes.name: Hierda

attributes.content: What are you calling... dead...
attributes.name: Suffering Infected

attributes.content: Blyat! I thought—I thought you had gone to heaven already, you lucky bastard!
attributes.name: Optimistic Infected

attributes.content: It doesn't hurt anymore... thank you.
attributes.name: Suffering Infected

attributes.content: I don't know who you are or how you did it, but could you help that guy over there too?
attributes.name: Suffering Infected

attributes.content: I apologize on his behalf. He might be a rude mudak, but he was only worried about me.
attributes.name: Suffering Infected

attributes.content: Hey!
attributes.name: Optimistic Infected

attributes.content: Of course.
attributes.name: Hierda

attributes.content: This is what I came for...
attributes.name: Hierda

attributes.content: She speaks softly as she takes the other Infected's hand.
A warm, dazzling light surrounds the Infected. He feels himself rejuvenated and even stands up from the ground.
This is amazing... I got better all of a sudden! It's better than any medicine! How could this be?
attributes.name: Optimistic Infected

attributes.content: What are you—
attributes.name: Optimistic Infected

attributes.content: Oh, Doctor Nadezhda! I-I'm not saying your medicine's bad! Not at all!
attributes.name: Optimistic Infected

attributes.content: Uh...
attributes.name: Optimistic Infected

attributes.content: Doctor Nadezhda...
attributes.name: Hierda

attributes.content: (Is that the doctor the man in the underground layer was talking about?)
attributes.name: Hierda

attributes.content: Hierda turns around to see that a door has opened at the end of the corridor.
The fluorescent white light of an operating room shines through the door, where a masked middle-aged woman wearing a white coat and gloves is standing.
Doctor...
attributes.name: Hierda

attributes.content: The doctor shakes her head, wipes her hands with a towel and puts on her gloves again, before waving Hierda over.
So you're that one they say removes people's pain with Arts.
attributes.name: Nadezhda

attributes.content: You know of me?
attributes.name: Hierda

attributes.content: I thought you might come. I've already lost a bunch of patients thanks to you.
attributes.name: Nadezhda

attributes.content: You may have cured their ailment, but you've also cost me a large chunk of my income.
attributes.name: Nadezhda

attributes.content: I thought you were a doctor...
attributes.name: Hierda

attributes.content: Does a doctor not need to eat? Besides, legally speaking, I'm not a doctor anymore. My license was revoked. I'm working unlicensed now.
attributes.name: Nadezhda

attributes.content: I'm trying to make enough money to get my license back. What do you think I should do with someone who's ruined my livelihood?
attributes.name: Nadezhda

attributes.content: I regret it, but I can't just stand by and watch when there are patients who need my help.
attributes.name: Hierda

attributes.content: Seeing the girl's nervous expression, the face beneath the mask seems to relax.
Just a bad attempt at a joke. Don't mind it. The atmosphere here is depressing enough as it is.
attributes.name: Nadezhda

attributes.content: But I am curious how you manage to do it. You have such incredible Arts, yet all you do is travel and preach like the Yurodstvo, without charging a single coin?
attributes.name: Nadezhda

attributes.content: I can't explain my powers... but please understand that I mean no harm.
attributes.name: Hierda

attributes.content: Well, you certainly look cute, but I'm not in the habit of trusting someone who gives without asking for anything in return.
attributes.name: Nadezhda

attributes.content: What are you here for, little bunny?
attributes.name: Nadezhda

attributes.content: Doctor Nadezhda! I have an emergency here!
attributes.name: Frantic Infected

attributes.content: Never seen this one before, but he's in bad shape—
attributes.name: Frantic Infected

attributes.content: Huh? You're here too, Hierda?
attributes.name: Frantic Infected

attributes.content: Oh... it's been a few days, hasn't it? You seem to be in better spirits now.
attributes.name: Hierda

attributes.content: Enough chit-chat, let me see the patient.
attributes.name: Nadezhda

attributes.content: Put on protective clothing immediately, Borislav, and prepare the surgery room.
attributes.name: Nadezhda

attributes.content: Gotcha!
attributes.name: Borislav

attributes.content: ...Belay that, take a dose of metabolism inhibitor right now, and try to get in touch with Tonya.
attributes.name: Nadezhda

attributes.content: I'll deal with the surgery myself.
attributes.name: Nadezhda

attributes.content: Hierda hears the patient's weak, pained cries as the bed is pushed past her.
She instinctively reaches out, hoping to give her usual help, but fails to give the patient any comfort.
Hierda follows the patient as he is pushed into the operating room, but she could do no more than let go of the hand in front of the operating room door.
Thank goodness...
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: Did you find this patient?
attributes.name: Hierda

attributes.content: I should... thank you...
attributes.name: Hierda

attributes.content: Just doing what I can... are you a doctor here?
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: The patient's condition is very unusual. It's not like any Oripathy I've seen before... I'm not even sure if it's Oripathy at all.
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: Do you know—
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: No, I'm not a doctor... I wish I was.
attributes.name: Hierda

attributes.content: But I can't heal them. What I can do is so limited...
attributes.name: Hierda

attributes.content: I'm sorry, I got ahead of myself. I take it you are a cleric?
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: It's alright, I didn't notice either... that you're so sick too.
attributes.name: Hierda

attributes.content: You mean my condition...? How can you tell?
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: No, you're not like the others... you're very ill, but you're not seeking salvation, and I shouldn't do anything for you...
attributes.name: Hierda

attributes.content: But how do you endure it, when you carry so much pain with you?
attributes.name: Hierda

attributes.content: I'm sorry, I don't understand—
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: The diminutive Cautus casts her gaze towards the operating room.
I feel pain... a lot of pain.
attributes.name: Hierda

attributes.content: I thought I didn't feel pain anymore, but I still feel such heavy pain when I see these people suffer...
attributes.name: Hierda

attributes.content: Why... why does God make people suffer?
attributes.name: Hierda

attributes.content: Why does she put such trials upon them... is suffering God's law?
attributes.name: Hierda

attributes.content: Amiya is perplexed.
The Cautus before her seems even younger than her, but there is a sort of altruism with her that seems incongruent with her age.
Even without the black crown appearing, the Sarkaz King's power links Amiya's consciousness with her counterpart.
She does not sense any strong emotion, only a disjointed cloud, or a roiling ocean. The endless sorrow in the girl's consciousness threatens to swallow her.
Amiya is not willing to delve any further.
But my understanding is that this is not in line with Lateran law—sorry, I don't mean to offend your religion.
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: I don't think any suffering has to be inevitable. The pain imposed upon us is something that we should fight with all our strength.
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: To help those who are suffering and defeat the ones inflicting the suffering... that's what we should do.
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: But there are always people who can't be saved.
attributes.name: Hierda

attributes.content: There's always suffering, with no end in sight... does what we do really have meaning?
attributes.name: Hierda

attributes.content: Do you not despair?
attributes.name: Hierda

attributes.content: Perhaps.
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: I would have been crushed by despair, if I were on my own.
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: But I'm never by myself, never have been...
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: Someone once told me of her dream, of her vision for this land... when people will overcome their differences, and Terra becomes a home for everyone.
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: Her dream has inspired and united many people. I have borne witness to the legacy of that dream, and I'm certain that people will continue to carry it on.
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: I don't know how to completely eliminate suffering, of course. I suppose that's something only 'God' can do.
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: There may be no end to suffering, but hope continues to live on.
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: A home for everyone...
attributes.name: Hierda

attributes.content: How is he, doctor?
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: Where did you find him?
attributes.name: Nadezhda

attributes.content: First District, in an alley by the factories.
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: It's quite far from Kirill's home.
attributes.name: Nadezhda

attributes.content: He must have known that he didn't have long to live, and he didn't want to be found by people who knew him... poor Tonya is still looking for him.
attributes.name: Nadezhda

attributes.content: Do you mean...?
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: I've done all I can, but his basic biological functions have completely failed... all I can do is mitigate his pain in some measure.
attributes.name: Nadezhda

attributes.content: Is there anything we can do?
attributes.name: Hierda

attributes.content: Even the most miraculous Arts cannot reverse total failure of biological function.
attributes.name: Nadezhda

attributes.content: But feel free to try to ease his pain with your Arts, if he wakes up.
attributes.name: Nadezhda

attributes.content: Did you find medicine, Amiya?
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Closure—
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: I just found a doctor. Give me a moment.
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: Doctor Nadezhda, do you have medicine for Arts overload reactions here?
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: Arts overload reaction? What are the symptoms? Weakness in the limbs, or brain fatigue?
attributes.name: Nadezhda

attributes.content: She lost consciousness... we don't have enough emergency medicine. Can we get some from you?
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: Lost consciousness? That sounds serious...
attributes.name: Nadezhda

attributes.content: I can't just give you that sort of medicine without ascertaining the patient's condition. I'll come with you.
attributes.name: Nadezhda

attributes.content: Alright...
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: Doctor—
attributes.name: Hierda

attributes.content: Metabolism inhibitor for you. I wasn't joking. Stay behind and help him, if you're willing.
attributes.name: Nadezhda

attributes.content: There's no obligation. If you don't want to help, you're free to leave on your own.
attributes.name: Nadezhda

attributes.content: Borislav will be bringing Tonya over. She's been looking for the patient. There'll be someone taking care of him.
attributes.name: Nadezhda

attributes.content: Oh, and... Amiya's the name, right? Take a dose of metabolism inhibitor, since you've been in contact with that patient. Not that it's much more than a placebo, given how little we know about this sickness.
attributes.name: Nadezhda

attributes.content: Alright, let's go.
attributes.name: Nadezhda

attributes.content: ...Wait!
attributes.name: Hierda

attributes.content: Amiya... that's your name, right?
attributes.name: Hierda

attributes.content: Yes.
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: My name is... Hierda.
attributes.name: Hierda

attributes.content: Maybe we'll meet again—
attributes.name: Hierda

attributes.content: Where is the patient? Lead the way.
attributes.name: Nadezhda

attributes.content: O-Okay—Sorry, Hierda...
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: ...Will we meet again?
attributes.name: Hierda

attributes.content: Hierda walks into the operating room after the others have left.
The disintegrating patient has been moved to a bed, surrounded by transparent tarp sheets as a temporary quarantine measure, making it hard to see clearly.
Hierda walks closer, and sees that the patient's chest continues to rise and fall underneath the new bandages.
Ugh...
attributes.name: Strange Patient

attributes.content: You're awake? How are you feeling?
attributes.name: Hierda

attributes.content: ...It hurts...
attributes.name: Strange Patient

attributes.content: Help me... help me.
attributes.name: Strange Patient

attributes.content: I-I can't end your pain. I tried, but I couldn't liberate you from your pain like I do with the others—
attributes.name: Hierda

attributes.content: Ugh...
attributes.name: Strange Patient

attributes.content: Is there anything I can do to make you feel better?
attributes.name: Hierda

attributes.content: Argh—ugh...
attributes.name: Strange Patient

attributes.content: ...Kill...
attributes.name: Strange Patient

attributes.content: What did you say?
attributes.name: Hierda

attributes.content: Kill...
attributes.name: Strange Patient

attributes.content: Me.
attributes.name: Strange Patient

attributes.content: Kill you...?
attributes.name: Hierda

attributes.content: I can't see... Mulka.
attributes.name: Strange Patient

attributes.content: My Mulka—
attributes.name: Strange Patient

attributes.content: You can't get up—
attributes.name: Hierda

attributes.content: *cough* *cough*!!
attributes.name: Strange Patient

attributes.content: You need to stay still and conserve your strength. Using up your energy now will only make it hurt more later.
attributes.name: Hierda

attributes.content: Do you need something? I'll help you.
attributes.name: Hierda

attributes.content: *cough*...
attributes.name: Strange Patient

attributes.content: I went to where we first met.
attributes.name: Strange Patient

attributes.content: I saw you sitting there with a cloudbeast in your arms.
attributes.name: Strange Patient

attributes.content: How strange, when you're already gone...
attributes.name: Strange Patient

attributes.content: Argh—
attributes.name: Strange Patient

attributes.content: Sir!
attributes.name: Hierda

attributes.content: What do I want...? I want to die...
attributes.name: Strange Patient

attributes.content: Kill me. Don't give me any more hope.
attributes.name: Strange Patient

attributes.content: Don't let her see me as I am now...
attributes.name: Strange Patient

attributes.content: No, maybe... maybe I can—
attributes.name: Hierda

attributes.content: She cannot describe her sudden impulse. Does she want to fulfill his wish, or help him live on less painfully?
There is no act of resolve. Hierda simply reaches out again and places her hand upon his heaving chest.
(I ask you to grant another wish.)
attributes.name: Hierda

attributes.content: (May your blessings be upon all of us equally.)
attributes.name: Hierda

attributes.content: (Even if Oripathy is not the reason for his pain, even if he could not know your name...)
attributes.name: Hierda

attributes.content: I hope, from the bottom of my heart, that you will be far from pain.
attributes.name: Hierda

attributes.content: The skin, a sickly green covered in red blood, peels off like moss. The soft flesh beneath has hardened.
Orange rocks begin to replace what is left of the man. Hierda's eyes go wide; she has never seen a transformation like this before.
Finally, a small smile appears upon the patient's face.
...If you see 'Mur'...
attributes.name: Strange Patient

attributes.content: Help me...
attributes.name: Strange Patient

attributes.content: Thank him for his companionship.
attributes.name: Strange Patient

attributes.content: What did you do?
I... I didn't—
attributes.name: Hierda

attributes.content: I don't think I was seeing things.
attributes.name: Calm Youth

attributes.content: Please explain—what did you just do to this patient?
attributes.name: Calm Youth

attributes.content: <p=1>Marshal's Manor, Zelgrad Expansion Plate</>
attributes.name: group_location_stamp

attributes.content: The young man deftly brushes the dead body to one side with his sword, takes a silk handkerchief from a servant, and begins to wipe away the blood from the blade.
So, tell me...
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: What do you mean when you say you don't know where she is?
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: ...We sent someone to follow Gospozha Hierda, but we lost track of her after she entered the underground residential layer.
attributes.name: Brave Servant

attributes.content: We began searching for her immediately, and we have narrowed down the search to an illegal Infected squatter zone that we have been trying to eliminate.
attributes.name: Brave Servant

attributes.content: We believe that Gospozha Hierda went there to... perform her miracles.
attributes.name: Brave Servant

attributes.content: Perform her miracles... Hmph. Who told her she could hand out blessings like that? Does she think everyone deserves this salvation?
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: Generalik! We found an illicit gathering in the Third District while pursuing the assassin!
attributes.name: Soldier

attributes.content: These Infected are in violation of curfew, and attempting to resist arrest. They may be a diversion for the assassin—
attributes.name: Soldier

attributes.content: Your orders, sir?
attributes.name: Soldier

attributes.content: Both the Third District and the main urban area where Gospozha Hierda might be are not far from here.
attributes.name: Brave Servant

attributes.content: 'Might be'?
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: ...In fact, we are certain she's there.
attributes.name: Brave Servant

attributes.content: Then we'll go to the Third District.
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: It's too late... he's dead.
attributes.name: Pavel

attributes.content: We saw it! This girl used Arts on him, and then he died!
attributes.name: Pavel

attributes.content: The youth gives Pavel a wave off.
We do not wish to harm someone who is unarmed. We would appreciate it if you could provide us with information that demonstrates you are not hostile.
attributes.name: Calm Youth

attributes.content: I didn't harm him... I just didn't want him to continue to be in pain.
attributes.name: Hierda

attributes.content: The doctor could not treat his condition, and I couldn't save his life.
attributes.name: Hierda

attributes.content: He was sick? What sort of illness?
attributes.name: Calm Youth

attributes.content: I want to know too... I've never seen it before.
attributes.name: Hierda

attributes.content: The youth steps forward to the side of the bed, carefully examining the dead patient's terrifying cadaver...
The expression does not change in the slightest.
This validates our hypothesis. Whatever secret the Army is hiding in Zelgrad, it's killing the people here.
attributes.name: Calm Youth

attributes.content: Zelgrad is not paradise for the Infected. We must tell people the truth, and get them out of here.
attributes.name: Calm Youth

attributes.content: You're right, but how are we going to get the word out when we have a hard time getting the group together?
attributes.name: Pavel

attributes.content: You... want to take the people here away?
attributes.name: Hierda

attributes.content: I have friends here who will believe me... I can contact them, if you're willing to take them with you.
attributes.name: Hierda

attributes.content: We would love to be able to trust you, young lady, but how do you prove that you can be trusted?
attributes.name: Calm Youth

attributes.content: ...I can tell you about the Generalik's troop deployments here—
attributes.name: Hierda

attributes.content: What's happening?!
attributes.name: Pavel

attributes.content: We didn't alarm any soldiers on our way here!
attributes.name: Pavel

attributes.content: Maybe somebody else caught their attention.
attributes.name: Calm Youth

attributes.content: No time for analysis. We pull out according to plan.
attributes.name: Calm Youth

attributes.content: As for you, young lady—
attributes.name: Calm Youth

attributes.content: ...I'll come with you.
attributes.name: Hierda
